decisions.accepted: Exact identities/correctness; general 1M and 1000ms grouped lower95 > 1 and both order point estimates >1; no other aggregate upper95<1; endgame100ms lower95>1/1.03; no established or unresolved material regression; <=25% flagged blocks, stable-block and length2 bootstrap long-control points/intervals do not contradict gain.
decisions.established_regression: Per-position repeat95 upper bound <1/1.03, or endgame100ms grouped upper95<1/1.03. Classify REJECTED. Intervals are unadjusted; inspect consistency across orders/controls.
decisions.inconclusive: Any other failure of acceptance, excessive environment noise, conflicting CPU/wall or temporal/order evidence, incomplete schedule, unresolved concerning regression.
decisions.rejected: Correctness failure, established material regression, or both general long-control upper95<=1 (gain disappears).
decisions.unresolved: Observed material median is not automatically a defect: flag as unresolved if repeat95 upper<1 but >=1/1.03, or both order medians<1/1.03 AND a second control on same fixture has material median. Isolated short-time material medians whose intervals include1 may be noise only if both 1M and1000ms fixture points>1 and no consistent neighboring-control/order loss; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE.

environment_policy.ac_and_power_plan: Check before/after every position/repeat block; stop on change; do not alter settings
environment_policy.invalid: Engine crash, illegal/protocol failure or externally verified power/plan interruption only. Preserve partial pair and reason, stop; never remove inconvenient performance. Resume repeats only incomplete pairs; prior valid pairs retained.

restrictions: Validation only; exact preserved executables; no rebuild, optimization, training, labeling, sealed split, tournaments or production promotion
statistic: exp(mean(per-position median(log(paired candidate wall-NPS / baseline wall-NPS)))); fixed nodes equivalent inverse wall time
uncertainty: 10000 hierarchical bootstrap draws: positions/groups then paired repeats; sentinel repeat-only. Seed 2026101731. Circular moving-block repeat bootstrap length 2 and early/late halves as dependence sensitivities. No multiplicity correction; not universal/random-workload confidence.
